children: Jacob DeWitte, a 10% owner and Co-Founder serving as Chief Executive Officer, reported five sales of Class A common stock on September 1, 2026 effected pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted on March 31, 2025, at weighted average prices of $38.40, $38.56, $38.66, $38.88 and $39.15 per share for a total aggregate sale amount of $4,631,254; following the reported transactions DeWitte directly owns 431,533 Class A common shares and indirectly owns 19,839,805 Class A common shares.

Caroline Cochran, a 10% owner and Co-Founder serving as Chief Operating Officer, reported five sales of Class A common stock on September 1, 2026 effected pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 plan at weighted average prices including $38.66, $38.88, $39.15, $38.40 and $38.56 per share for a total aggregate sale amount of $4,631,254; following the reported transactions Cochran directly owns 398,039 Class A common shares and indirectly owns 19,873,299 Class A common shares.
